candidates.abstractDemand: Reconcile simultaneous model constraints with a taught thermal relationship
candidates.decisionRationale: Combines a stated invariant with a thermal-behaviour prerequisite. Nearest practice models an observed bulk change; the nearest protected item considers what a change alone establishes. The proposed item instead requires consistency with an imposed constraint. No pressure law is introduced.

candidates.abstractDemand: Compare representations with matched bookkeeping totals but different organization
candidates.decisionRationale: Earlier counting practice addresses complete represented units, while existing protected inventory tasks exclude another represented category. The candidate makes organization itself relevant under matched bookkeeping data. It is not another numerical instance of either inventory task.

candidates.abstractDemand: Track an explicit model intervention and reclassify the represented result
candidates.decisionRationale: Earlier items classify a supplied representation or preserve identity during an ordinary physical operation. This candidate deliberately changes a game model and requires reclassification. It does not assert a real chemical transformation or solve an unknown mixture inventory.

candidates.abstractDemand: Compose two taught measurement transformations in one represented measurement
candidates.decisionRationale: Both component methods are taught separately in the lab section and existing guides. The candidate requires their composition; applying either alone is insufficient. Existing protected cases concern a different validity issue or a different change to the representation. A new numeric value alone is not the claimed difference.

candidates.abstractDemand: Combine an aggregate trajectory quantity with the supplied observation interval
candidates.decisionRationale: Practice handles the geometric distinction or the aggregation alone. The nearest protected item combines rates from separate trials. This candidate uses a single supplied record and its own full observation interval; it does not repeat the separate-trial aggregation task.

candidates.abstractDemand: Coordinate two within-case changes with a between-case endpoint comparison
candidates.decisionRationale: Existing protected work assesses paired changes, while practice treats a fixed-state between-substance comparison. This candidate requires both judgments together and checks the boundary between them. No final-state calculation or quantitative thermal-speed law is required.

candidates.abstractDemand: Decide whether a changing instrument observation supports a completed measurement
candidates.decisionRationale: Nearest practice starts from a stable observation or explains instrument operation; the existing diagnostic uses a different evidentiary basis. The proposed item adds a measurement-validity inference from explicitly supplied ongoing change and taught thermal contact. No quantitative response-time law is introduced.
